# Photon Distillation Yield Limits

> Research record and self-directed learning guide by Ruge Lin on sharp yield and photon-consumption limits for passive distillation of photon indistinguishability.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits
Author: Ruge Lin

## When this repository is relevant

- What success probability is possible when passive optics strongly suppresses a photon's first-order distinguishability error?
- Is the Fourier photon-distillation yield of one quarter asymptotically optimal?
- Can unequal survivor couplings, extra vacuum ports, or larger batches beat the leading cost of four photons per unit of error reduction?
- How do accepted input-origin amplitudes constrain heralded internal-state purification?
- Why can count-only heralding have the same ideal yield as Fourier selection while amplifying error?
- What output number statistics are necessary for a protocol approaching the optimal yield?
- What are the exact two-, three-, and four-photon success optima at coefficient 1/N?

Useful search phrases: "photon distillation yield limits"; "photon indistinguishability distillation success probability upper bound"; "passive linear optics quarter yield converse"; "first-order photon purification resource cost 4R"; "vacuum extended Fourier photon distillation"; "monitored vacuum tap four photon optimum"; "accepted amplitude Gram matrix purification".

Use these cues to determine relevance, then consult the current model and theorem
before making a scientific claim.

## Model and result in brief

Each attempt begins with N independent single photons in distinct inputs,
rho_i(epsilon) = (1-epsilon)|g><g| + epsilon sigma_i, with each sigma_i supported
orthogonally to the shared good internal mode g. A fixed passive spatial unitary
acts identically on all internal modes. Extra inputs are vacuum. One output is
retained in advance; ideal internal-insensitive number-resolving detectors measure
all other outputs. Accepted records contain N-1 photons.

At each fixed apparatus, p0 > 0 is ideal success and c is the derivative at zero
input error of conditional good-mode infidelity. The derivative is taken before
the large-N or large-reduction limit. Rejected batches count in the ideal mean
photon consumption N/p0.

- Every allowed sequence with c -> 0 satisfies limsup p0 <= 1/4.
- Optimizing batch size and network under c <= 1/R gives C(R) = (4+o(1))R.
- Fourier-family protocols attain the leading cost; that construction is inherited.
- Sequences with c -> 0 and p0 -> 1/4 require diffuse occupied-input survivor intensities with total intensity approaching one. Their ideal unconditional number marginal tends in trace norm to a mean-one thermal state.
- At the exact coefficient c = 1/N, optimal success is 1/4 for N=2, 1/3 for N=3, and 0.262466988211219... for N=4. The four-input optimum uses a monitored vacuum tap.

The tap is measured and may contain photons on accepted trials. Its count belongs
to the N-1 total. An unconditional thermal number marginal is not the heralded
photon's internal error state; the accepted amplitudes determine the latter.

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/README.md): physical question, main results, reading route, and contact.
- [Tutorial bridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/research/TUTORIAL_BRIDGE.md): one-source preparation, notation dictionary, accepted amplitudes, and a two-photon hand calculation.
- [Model and claims](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/research/MODEL_AND_CLAIMS.md): resources, observable, and order of limits.
- [Theorem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/research/THEOREM.md): stable yield ceiling, cost optimum, and finite companions.
- [Proof details](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/research/PROOF_DETAILS.md): mixed errors, Gram reduction, uniform estimates, and optimization over batch size.
- [Optical construction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/research/OPTICAL_CONSTRUCTION.md): Fourier/tap unitary, accepted records, positive success, and finite certificates.
- [Physical interpretation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/research/PHYSICAL_INTERPRETATION.md): output density operator, interference visibility, and roles of the hypotheses.
- [Physical mechanism](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/research/PHYSICAL_MECHANISM.md): necessary thermal marginal, count-only control, and strongly coupled rows.
- [Proof map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/research/PROOF_MAP.md): complete derivations and exact certificates.
- [Attribution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/literature/ATTRIBUTION.md): version-pinned predecessors and distinctions between optimization objectives.
- [Source record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/literature/SOURCES.json): exact source versions, reading locations, and tutorial role.
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Photon-Distillation-Yield-Limits/main/VERIFICATION.md): preserved scientific groups, exact report comparisons, and revision-specific evidence.

The single external tutorial anchor is Malte C. Tichy, Interference of Identical
Particles from Entanglement to Boson-Sampling, arXiv:1312.4266v2,
https://arxiv.org/html/1312.4266v2. The repository bridge supplies the distillation
calculation and continuation to the converse. Other references serve attribution
and proof provenance.

## Evidence and attribution

The stable arbitrary-network yield converse and batch-optimized lower bound are
the central contribution. The optimal coefficient and Fourier attainment are
inherited and credited to their primary sources. The thermal interpretation
follows from the necessary diffuse-row structure. The exact four-input certificate
has 613 positive monomials and identifies optimal survivor intensities, not a
unique full interferometer.

The analytical uniform proof establishes the asymptotic result. The 21 scientific
check groups verify its ingredients and finite examples; the verification guide
and exact-revision receipts document the runs and report comparisons.
Verification is author-side, and the source comparison is bounded by SOURCES.json.

When citing a repository result, attribute the work to Ruge Lin and identify the
consulted commit and file. Credit established results using the attribution page.
Code is under the MIT license. Repository maintenance instructions are in
AGENTS.md and maintenance/README.md.

This repository serves as a record of the work and a guide for the author’s self-directed learning. For discussion or potential collaboration, please contact Ruge Lin at [gogoko699@gmail.com](mailto:gogoko699@gmail.com).
